newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis firm, few trades seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis firm, few trades seen.

text.p: Soymeal basis offers were unchanged to higher Tuesday, but traders said there were few trades following an increase in basis on Monday.
"The market is firmer, but I don't know if anything is trading at these levels," said one dealer.
On Monday, most rail basis offers rose by $1.00 to $2.00 in response to expectations for idle crushing plants and demand from processors, dealers said.
However, the increase did little to stimulate buying interest from end-users, dealers said.
"I haven't seen any really heavy end-user buying," said one broker. They're going to wait it out and give it a couple of weeks."
One Kentucky dealer said there was continued buying interest on the river, but quantities were small, he said.
"It seems like there may be a little bit more interest today, but just a little more," the river dealer said.
